paragraphs.text: Urza's Legacy features four distinctive preconstructed theme decks , each built around a specific two-color combination and designed to showcase different playstyles and strategic concepts. Each deck includes a selection of creatures, spells, and lands, accompanied by a booklet providing deck lists and strategic guidance. In addition to the base decks, Wizards of the Coast suggested enhanced versions intended for players looking to upgrade their decks for a more competitive Standard environment, though the additional cards for these enhancements were not supplied. The decks — Crusher, Phyrexian Assault, Radiant's Revenge, and Time Drain — offer a range of archetypes from aggressive creature swarms to control-oriented spell combinations, making them both accessible for new players and interesting for experienced collectors seeking thematic variety.
Crusher is an aggro green/white theme deck.
The rares in this deck are Defense of the Heart and Weatherseed Treefolk .
Phyrexian Assault is a black/red theme deck.
The rares in this deck are Molten Hydra and Phyrexian Plaguelord .
Radiant's Revenge is a white/blue theme deck.
The rares in this deck are Ring of Gix and Urza's Blueprints .
Time Drain is a green/blue theme deck with a "free spells" theme.
The rares in this deck are Anthroplasm and Archivist .
